title: Pan-Seared Fish with Gooey Nut Sauce
description: A Japanese-inspired dish featuring pan-seared fish with a rich, nutty, and gooey sauce. This recipe is perfect for a seafood lover's dinner.

ingredients.name: Pecans
ingredients.notes: Chopped pecans for the nut sauce

ingredients.name: Lemon juice
ingredients.notes: For adding a hint of citrus

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.notes: Unsalted butter for pan-searing the fish

instructions: Marinate the salmon fillet in a mixture of soy sauce, honey, lemon juice, ginger, and garlic for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and add butter.
Pan-sear the salmon fillet for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the pecans in a small pan over low heat until fragrant.
In a blender or food processor, combine the toasted pecans, a tablespoon of butter, and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Blend until smooth and creamy, adjusting the consistency as needed.
Serve the pan-seared salmon with the gooey nut sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with chopped scallions or sesame seeds, if desired.
